mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, name_normalized, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, version FROM catalog_category WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.household_id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.name_normalized, c.status, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.version FROM catalog_category c INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id WHERE c.household_id = #{householdId} ) SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, name_normalized, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, version FROM category_tree ORDER BY sort_order, id

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id FROM catalog_category WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND household_id = #{householdId} UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM catalog_category c INNER JOIN descendants d ON c.parent_id = d.id ) SELECT id FROM descendants

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, name_normalized, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, version FROM catalog_category WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND household_id = #{householdId} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.household_id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.name_normalized, c.status, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.version FROM catalog_category c INNER JOIN ancestors a ON c.id = a.parent_id ) SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, name_normalized, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, version FROM ancestors WHERE id != #{categoryId}
